nameOrigin: aquatic plant family that includes seaweed

pokedexEntries.x: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker, and they spit it indiscriminately at anything that enters their territory.

pokedexEntries.or: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker, and they spit it indiscriminately at anything that enters their territory.

pokedexEntries.y: Tales are told of ships that wander into seas where Dragalge live, never to return.

pokedexEntries.as: Tales are told of ships that wander into seas where Dragalge live, never to return.

pokedexEntries.us: This vicious Pokémon sprays a poisonous liquid on opponents that come near. For whatever reason, it gets along really well with Dhelmise.

pokedexEntries.um: It blends in with seaweed to ambush its prey and then takes them down with a poisonous liquid strong enough to melt metal.

pokedexEntries.sw: Dragalge uses a poisonous liquid capable of corroding metal to send tankers that enter its territory to the bottom of the sea.

pokedexEntries.sh: Dragalge generates dragon energy by sticking the plume on its head out above the ocean’s surface and bathing it in sunlight.

pokedexEntries.sc: Using a liquid poison, Dragalge indiscriminately attacks anything that wanders into its territory. This poison can corrode the undersides of boats.

pokedexEntries.vi: Since Finizen is the better swimmer, Dragalge will approach it under the cover of seaweed, then immobilize it with a poisonous attack.

pokedexEntries.za: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker, and they spit it indiscriminately at anything that enters their territory.
